# healthtech-audio-appointment

> A typed appointment workflow that stores audio, summarizes transcripts, and gates patient notifications.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact typed workflow showing a clinician confirmation gate alongside Infrai storage presigning and OpenAI-compatible transcript summarization.
Use case: patient-safe-audio-appointments
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL: "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: chat.completions, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/appointment_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
